mb.label: Menu
mb.shortcutsText:
Type on a cell — starts editing right away (no Enter needed)
Enter / F2 / double-click — edit the cell
Arrows while typing — save and move
Tab — save and move right
Tab on a gray suggestion — use it
→ at the end of a gray suggestion — fill it in and keep typing
Delete at the end of a gray suggestion — drop it
Escape — cancel the edit
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V — copy / paste (also a range)
Delete — clear the selected cells
Drag the corner of a cell — fill (like Excel)
Ctrl+Z — undo
Right-click — more options for the cell

tour.title: Demo tour
tour.finished: That's the whole tour. Thanks for trying ContaBu.

s1.d: You land in your own office with 3 client books.

s2.d: The Sheet shows what no rule covers yet (Pending), and the P&L says how much is still uncategorized.

s3.t: Ask the team to propose rules
s3.d: Review the proposal (coverage and clashes already checked), approve it, and watch Pending drop live.

s4.d: The team found a merchant categorized two ways and rules that clash. Click an Observation to read the full report.

s5.d: Then approve another rule: your manual row doesn't move. What you write by hand wins.

s6.d: Teller sandbox (user username, password password). New transactions come in and the rules categorize them.

s7.d: The same kind of purchase is audited differently because of the bookkeeper's note.
